transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this final production meeting started. We've got the recording plan drafted — four stagehands on a four-hour crew call for the internal archive video at the Orpheum on September 18. Before I can approve it, I need the artist liaison and labor coordinator to confirm their respective areas. Let's hear from you both.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue before we go any further. I received the artist's signed performance rider this morning, and it directly conflicts with the current recording plan. The rider permits an audio-only archival recording only, explicitly prohibits any video recording, and requires the archive credit to read exactly 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set'. I haven't attached it to the production file yet, but this means the video recording plan as drafted cannot be approved. We need to revise to an audio-only format and update the credit line before I can confirm my area.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a labor compliance issue with the current recording plan. I confirmed with the theater's labor representative today that recording calls require exactly six stagehands and a minimum five-hour call under the local agreement. The current draft of four stagehands on a four-hour crew call falls short on both counts and has not been revised since that confirmation. I cannot confirm my area until the staffing is updated to six stagehands and the call length is extended to at least five hours.
transcript.speaker: A3
